dedup_provenance.note: Two filters, applied in order. (1) Cohort-inclusion policy (see common.CORE_COHORTS): run_level_long_master.csv pools non-exchangeable cohorts under the same nominal (scenario, mechanism, severity) label — verified on lead-slow/range_clip/S0, where supplementary_formal_60 gives travel_time_s ~127s, visual_replication ~97s and early_20260822 ~80s for the 'same' cell. Excluded rows are kept, never discarded, in run_level_long_excluded_cohorts.csv / cohort_excluded_runs_by_mechanism.csv. (2) Dedup key = (scenario, mechanism, severity, repeat); when two run_id occupy the same logical slot, the alphabetically-first run_id is kept and the other is recorded in dedup_dropped_runs.csv.
